package: UdaanSetu cumulative prototype: Phases 01–30 with curated Resource Hub and Telugu localization
increment: Resource-discovery product direction: curated external learning links for coding, school resources, open courses, skills, exams, scholarships and careers; fourth-language Telugu interface and learner-pathway guidance; bookmark/search regression tests and source-governance notes. Expanded curated education directory with India-focused school/open-learning sources and coding-practice destinations; completed Telugu locale handling in offline learner storage and partner module language selection.
title: Curated Education Resource Hub and Telugu Localization
status: persistence-and-query-hardening-implemented-in-source; real Maven/npm/container verification pending network-enabled environment

phaseManifest.title: Platform foundation and experience shell
phaseManifest.acceptance: React/JavaScript experience shell, Java Spring Boot API, Python FastAPI boundary, PWA static shell and local developer documentation.

phaseManifest.title: Language-first onboarding
phaseManifest.acceptance: Language preference updates the integrated journey; English, Hindi, Tamil and Telugu labels are supported on the main shell and learner journey. All 36 states/UTs appear in the broad region dropdown.

phaseManifest.title: Learner profile and consent boundary
phaseManifest.acceptance: Debounced minimal local profile draft, save/resume/clear. Explicit demo opt-in is required for optional backend matching; regional selection stays local and the request excludes identity/contact fields. Server profiles are volatile with a 30-minute TTL and this is not production authentication or legal consent.

phaseManifest.title: Strengths and interest discovery
phaseManifest.acceptance: Learners select multiple interests, strengths and goals; “I am not sure yet” is supported and selections can be revised.

phaseManifest.title: Career and skill taxonomy
phaseManifest.acceptance: Six starter pathways span vocational/technical, creative, community, green enterprise, analytical/business and education/language routes. All contain cautions and general resource references.

phaseManifest.title: Explainable career matching
phaseManifest.acceptance: Local and Java deterministic rule matchers return multiple options with matching signals; the displayed score is a relative ranking indicator and not a probability or validated aptitude assessment.

phaseManifest.title: Personalized learning pathway
phaseManifest.acceptance: Selected path produces three localized actionable milestones, source links, caution notes and an optional locally saved selection. Generic pathway detail can be requested without learner profile data.

phaseManifest.title: Learning Resources, Exams and Credentials Discovery
phaseManifest.acceptance: Curated link-only resource hub supports coding tutorials, school/college resources, courses, skills, exams, careers and aid. This does not claim a complete verified exam/credential catalogue or re-host third-party content.

phaseManifest.title: Opportunity data ingestion and review
phaseManifest.acceptance: Ingestion preview, source provenance, validation findings and a review-before-publish workflow are available.

phaseManifest.title: Scholarship and scheme discovery
phaseManifest.acceptance: Source-linked opportunity search includes scholarship, scheme, course and apprenticeship categories with expiry/source caveats.

phaseManifest.title: Eligibility and deadline checker
phaseManifest.acceptance: Deterministic eligibility checks distinguish matching rules, missing information, possible mismatch and unconfigured rules; source provider remains authoritative.

phaseManifest.title: Student opportunity action centre
phaseManifest.acceptance: Learners save actions locally, queue updates and can synchronize through the Java API when online.

phaseManifest.title: Grounded AI assistant
phaseManifest.acceptance: Assistant retrieves from supplied approved records, returns source references where supported and abstains when it has no supported evidence. Real LLM adapter is disabled by default.

phaseManifest.title: Voice interaction service
phaseManifest.acceptance: Browser-native speech recognition/synthesis is capability-detected with text alternatives and disclosure of browser/network limitations.

phaseManifest.title: Multilingual content framework
phaseManifest.acceptance: Core application/learner-journey labels are localized in English, Hindi and Tamil; third-party resources and all opportunity/partner content are not fully translated.

phaseManifest.title: Offline learner pocket
phaseManifest.acceptance: Public catalogue, local actions and learner journey preferences use browser storage abstraction; service worker excludes API/authenticated responses from cache. Local storage is not secure account storage.

phaseManifest.title: Synchronization and conflict recovery
phaseManifest.acceptance: Opportunity actions queue locally, batch sync when online, retain failed events and expose pending/synced state. Learner journey profile is local-first; it is not automatically synced.

phaseManifest.title: Facilitator workspace
phaseManifest.acceptance: A facilitator can create a cohort, add a learner only when consent is recorded, and record a referral only for a linked learner.

phaseManifest.title: Learning-module authoring
phaseManifest.acceptance: A module can be saved as a draft; publishing requires a title, summary, at least one lesson and an explicit access/price policy. No payment is collected.

phaseManifest.title: Mentor discovery and safe connection
phaseManifest.acceptance: Unverified profiles are not shown publicly; connection requests require consent, facilitator mediation and guardian/institution approval flags. Contact details are not returned.

phaseManifest.title: Apprenticeship, internship and employer listings
phaseManifest.acceptance: New listings remain unpublished until a reviewer approves; application and source URLs must be HTTPS. Seed listings are marked illustrative, not live vacancies.

phaseManifest.title: Partner/API integration adapters
phaseManifest.acceptance: The registry distinguishes the local catalogue from external sources and explicitly reports that no external network adapter is enabled in this increment.

phaseManifest.title: Reminders and notifications
phaseManifest.acceptance: A reminder can be scheduled/listed/acknowledged; due reminders become READY on read. Email/SMS remain preferences only until a provider is approved and configured.

phaseManifest.title: Monetization and sustainability
phaseManifest.acceptance: The product makes no payment calls and stores no payment-card/banking data; core student discovery is proposed to remain free, and interest capture validates possible payer models.

phaseManifest.title: Impact analytics and reporting
phaseManifest.acceptance: A fixed event vocabulary accepts low-risk event counters and stores aggregates only; summary requires a configured reviewer token; no event-level payloads or user identifiers are retained.

phaseManifest.title: Security, privacy and child-safety hardening
phaseManifest.acceptance: Consent preferences, data-rights request workflow, request correlation, security headers, body-length ceiling and coarse rate limiting are implemented. Real identity/RBAC, legally reviewed consent, persistent retention and end-to-end erasure remain required before a pilot.

phaseManifest.title: Integrated quality and AI evaluation
phaseManifest.acceptance: Python retrieval evaluation reports source hit rate and abstention accuracy over a deterministic small corpus; frontend and backend tests are added and wired into CI. Full React and Maven execution still needs a dependency-enabled environment.

phaseManifest.title: Deployment, observability and hackathon showcase
phaseManifest.acceptance: Health/info endpoints, non-secret release status, request correlation, production Nginx frontend image, non-root AI container, Docker Compose checks, CI and smoke-check scripts are included. Full container build/run and browser tests are required before the final demo.

phaseManifest.title: Durable opportunity catalogue and review queue
phaseManifest.status: implemented-source-level; database integration tests added; full Maven execution pending
phaseManifest.acceptance: Opportunity catalogue and human-review queue are persisted through JDBC; Flyway V1 creates tables and V2 adds the composite candidate/status index; local H2 and PostgreSQL profiles share the schema; integration tests cover persistence round-trip, duplicate state transitions, reviewed-seed preservation and created_at stability.

phaseManifest.title: Central reviewer policy and fail-closed identity boundary
phaseManifest.status: implemented-in-prototype; production identity provider still required
phaseManifest.acceptance: Review-only endpoints use shared DemoReviewerAccess, which rejects missing/short tokens; production profile blocks sensitive routes relying on spoofable prototype actor headers with a non-secret 503 problem response.

prototypeBoundaries: Learner profile server handling requires explicit demo-service processing opt-in, uses 30-minute volatile memory storage, resets on restart, and is not authentication or production consent.
Local rule-based pathway scores are heuristics, not validated psychometric scores, eligibility decisions or predictions of employment or success.
Phases 09–28 remain prototype slices; some modules use in-memory stores that reset when services restart.
Demo actor headers are prototype identifiers and not production authentication or authorization.
External partner APIs, outgoing SMS/email/push and payment checkout are not connected.
Some opportunity/partner information is starter/reference content and is not comprehensively localized or independently verified for current availability.
Full npm tests/build, Maven tests, Docker Compose build/run and real-device accessibility/connectivity tests must run before final release.
Static contract checks do not substitute for a dependency-aware compile, runtime integration and field validation.
Phases 02–07 provide an integrated local-first learner journey prototype; Phase 08 still uses starter resources and is not a verified exam/credential database.

Browser profile storage is convenience storage, not secure account storage. Optional backend profiles are volatile and TTL-limited; production authentication, guardian/safeguarding workflow and durable data-rights service are not implemented.

v0.6.0 persists the opportunity catalogue and opportunity review queue only. Facilitator, mentor, partner listing, notifications, learner profiles, consent ledger, and analytics stores remain in-memory or prototype-scoped.

The production profile fails closed for routes that depend on spoofable demo identity headers, but there is still no production identity provider or RBAC; those routes remain unavailable rather than secured by the prototype.

releaseEngineering.mavenBootstrap: backend/mvnw and backend/mvnw.cmd use Maven 3.9.11 when Maven 3.9+ is not present and verify the official distribution SHA-512 checksum before use.
releaseEngineering.strictGate: scripts/verify-release.sh runs the frontend test/build, Java clean verify, AI tests/evaluation, Compose validation, container builds and HTTP smoke test. Missing required tools count as failure.
releaseEngineering.ci: GitHub Actions runs frontend/backend/AI checks and then builds and starts the Compose stack to run HTTP smoke tests.
releaseEngineering.currentExecutionEvidence: 72/72 offline cross-layer contracts passed; 12 Python tests passed; deterministic retrieval smoke evaluation passed 7/7; 26 JS/JSX files parsed with zero syntax errors; modified Java persistence/security sources and persistence-test source compiled against temporary framework stubs; 28 JSON, 8 YAML, Maven POM XML and shell parsing passed. npm install failed with EAI_AGAIN resolving registry.npmjs.org; Maven wrapper failed DNS for repo.maven.apache.org; Docker/Compose are unavailable. Therefore no full npm/Vite build, Maven/Spring test run, Flyway runtime test, or container smoke is claimed.
releaseEngineering.reproducibility: Direct frontend dependencies are exact pins. package-lock.json must be generated on a network-enabled machine/CI and committed; CI uploads an artifact to assist with that step.
releaseEngineering.offlineContracts: scripts/check-integration-contracts.py checks frontend/backend pathway identifier parity, endpoint route parity, privacy field exclusions, local-first fallback, PWA API-cache exclusions and required tests/docs using Python standard library only.
releaseEngineering.learnerJourney: Phases 02–07 are integrated; Phase 08 includes starter learning source links and remains incomplete until a governed current exam/credential catalogue is added.
releaseEngineering.integrationContractChecks: scripts/check-integration-contracts.py verifies frontend/backend pathway-ID parity, API paths, explicit server opt-in, no unnecessary region transmission, complete region options, local draft persistence and test/documentation presence.
releaseEngineering.persistence: Flyway V1 creates opportunity catalogue and review queue tables; V2 adds a composite candidate_id/review_status lookup index. Duplicate staging uses the indexed query; startup seeding preserves reviewed edits; catalogue updates retain created_at. Default local development uses file-backed H2 and Compose uses PostgreSQL. Remaining feature stores are not yet migrated.
releaseEngineering.reviewerGate: All source-review, mentor-review and partner-listing reviewer endpoints reuse DemoReviewerAccess with consistent minimum token-length and constant-time comparison policy. This is prototype reviewer gating, not user authentication.
releaseEngineering.productionProfile: compose.production.yaml layers postgres,prod profiles and disables all prototype-identity-dependent mutation/reviewer endpoints until real authentication and RBAC are added.

resourceHub.model: Curated link directory; UdaanSetu stores metadata and URLs, not copies of external course, textbook, article, video or practice content.
resourceHub.caveat: Resource links and source checks are a starter set, not a guarantee of current availability or language coverage. Recheck sources before public release.
resourceHub.contentLanguagePolicy: The interface locale is separate from each provider resource language. Only label provider content as available in a language when confirmed by the provider.
